originality.rationale: Full motivating paper defines average-flow matrix and its flow-stable shift but treats connected graphs only through order ten. The strongest overlapping older source proves seven-edge path multisets distinguish the same pair; this does NOT imply that the complete weighted average of all simple paths differs (later-length terms can cancel it). Exact all-length totals, nonzero average-flow difference, and spectra are new relative to inspected sources. A natural finite complete parameter-class test; historical priority uncertain.

value.rationale: The new average-flow matrix explicitly calls for evaluation on distance-regular graph classes; the canonical two graphs with identical (16,6,2,2) parameters provide a natural comprehensive first benchmark. Their exact all-path averages show that compression into one rational diagonal scalar preserves a real nonisomorphism signal which adjacency/distance spectra lose; the full natural pair classification, exact coefficients and independent certificate make it reusable beyond a numerical example.
